# F-04a noise corpus

Synthetic clips for `NoiseCorpusTests` (specs/features/noise-suppression.md §10 rows 1–3, 5–6).
16 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian raw PCM, no header.

**Source and licence:** every clip is generated by `scripts/fixtures/gen_noise_corpus.py` (seeded,
deterministic) and is part of this repository under its licence. No recordings, no people, no downloads.
Regenerate with `python3 scripts/fixtures/gen_noise_corpus.py`; `--check` verifies the committed files.

Level calibration (nominal): 94 dB SPL = RMS 16384, so 70 dB SPL is RMS ~1035. Non-speech clips: 1.5 s quiet
cabin bed (RMS 60, gate warm-up) then 2.5 s of the event. Speech clips: 5 s of 70 dB road noise, synthetic
voiced speech (4 syllables, 300 ms on / 120 ms off) from frame 200 for 140 frames (10 ms frames).

| Clip | Content | Scripted label |
|---|---|---|
| horn.pcm | two-tone 420/510 Hz horn, 1.2 s | car_horn |
| indicator.pcm | 8 ms clicks every 400 ms | clicking |
| door_slam.pcm | low-passed thump, 70 ms decay | door |
| dog.pcm | three 150 ms barks | dog |
| wind.pcm | low-passed gusting noise | wind |
| road_70db.pcm | tyre/engine rumble at 70 dB | vehicle |
| music.pcm | instrumental chord sequence | music |
| keyboard.pcm | random key clicks | typing |
| speech_road_snr10.pcm | speech over road noise, 10 dB SNR | speech (in span) / vehicle |
| speech_road_snr5.pcm | speech over road noise, 5 dB SNR | speech (in span) / vehicle |

SNR is speech RMS over the whole speech span (pauses included) against the road noise RMS. At 5 dB the raw
mix stays under the F-04 2.2x energy rule, so the unit test records it as a known issue; the device row
(voice processing on) decides it.
